$comment: Squash-merge commits that landed on main WITHOUT a proof record, listed here rather than back-filled with invented evidence. Owner directive 7 requires a real record: commands actually run, exit codes actually observed, an independent checked_by. Writing one after the fact, from memory, for work whose output was never captured, would be a fabricated receipt -- the precise dishonesty the record exists to prevent. So the gap is named instead. scripts/lwb_check_proof.py --coverage skips exactly these shas and nothing else; adding an entry is a visible, reviewable act in a shared path, which is the point. DO NOT add a new entry to avoid writing a record.
$why_the_gap_existed: lwb_check_proof.py validated the records that existed and never asked whether one SHOULD exist, so an empty proof/ reported 'skipped (no records yet)' and exited 0. The gate could not fail. These five deliverables merged green through it. The --coverage mode added in PR #6 closes that; these five predate it.
